scope: Agent visual review of eight actual production-media native captures, not complete acceptance or a human usability study.
observations: Review and confirmation are separate; the exact source, approved destination and original setup arguments are visible.
Essential native controls and wrapped verification messages are readable without overlap in reviewed compact captures.
Original setup and removal windows show their actual completion text; durable Installed/Not installed states follow independent verification.
The installed view explicitly says the PDF reader itself is not qualified.
limits: The original decorative SumatraPDF logo uses the canonical fallback font and is horizontally clipped. This is not pixel-identical Windows font rendering.
The original Start SumatraPDF button remains visible but is not a qualified reader task. Close the original window with its title-bar X as described in the guide.
The outer broker shows bounded waiting progress rather than original installer percentage while the original window is active.
This review does not qualify arbitrary EXE installers or the PDF reader.
